title: Archive completed tickets with lean AI summaries
summary:
Completed work can move to the hidden Archive lane with agent-compressed ticket bodies so long Requirements and Acceptance Criteria stay while narrative sections shrink.
- Tiered summarization via ticket.update (soft epic, medium feature, aggressive task)
- Archive buttons on completed task cards; container bundles summarize bottom-up before status moves
- Refresh frontmatter summary/excerpt after rewrite
Sequential agent runs per bundle need busy UI and fail-closed behavior if summarization fails.
context: Relay already supports an Archive column (hidden from the main board) and container archive controls that only call moveTicket. Completed standalone tasks lack archive UI. Tickets grow large over time; archiving should preserve Requirements and Acceptance Criteria while leaning the rest, with softer compression for epics than tasks.
researchFindings: src/renderer/src/lib/boardArchive.ts: featureCanArchive/epicCanArchive gate containers; archiveBundleForFeature/Epic return bundle ids; completedColumnArchivable checks completed column only.

src/renderer/src/App.tsx archiveBundle (lines ~1978-2005) loops moveTicketMutation to RELAY_ARCHIVE_STATUS with no body rewrite; archiveEpic/archiveFeature use it; BoardTicketCard/BoardTaskCardLeading omit showArchive/onArchive for tasks.

src/services/codex/index.ts: startTicketUpdateRun + buildTicketUpdatePrompt + applyAgentTicketPatch (fullMarkdown replace); purpose today is default|scope_recovery (agentTicketUpdateInputSchema in src/shared/schemas/ticket.ts); approveScopeClarificationRedraft shows fixed-request + purpose pattern.

agentTicketUpdateSchema patch.summary is not persisted to frontMatter.summary today; board excerpt uses ticketPreviewSummary (src/shared/ticketSummary.ts) at readBoard time in src/storage/filesystem.ts.
Ticket markdown template sections: Context, Goal, Requirements, Acceptance Criteria, Test Plan, Implementation Notes, Codex Handoff (src/renderer/src/lib/markdown.ts, src/storage/filesystem.ts).

tests/board-archive.test.ts covers eligibility/bundles; tests/ticket-update.test.ts covers structured ticket.update runs; tests/board-archive-button.test.tsx covers container archive button placement.
requirements: Add ticket.update purpose archive with tiered prompts: epic soft trim, feature medium, task aggressive; always keep Requirements and Acceptance Criteria; use patch.fullMarkdown rewrite (not append).
On successful archive update: persist lean markdown, set frontMatter.summary from patch.summary, transition ticket status to archive.
Task archive eligibility: ticketType task, status completed only; containers keep featureCanArchive/epicCanArchive gates.
Bundle archive summarizes bottom-up (tasks, then features, then epic) before each ticket's status move; do not archive on agent failure.
Expose archive on completed task board cards and completed task detail; replace container/task archiveBundle move-only flow with summarize-then-archive.
Refresh board excerpt after archive via existing ticketPreviewSummary on next board read.
implementationPlan: Extend agentTicketUpdateInputSchema purpose with archive; add buildArchiveTicketUpdatePrompt(ticketType) and fixed archive request string in src/services/codex/index.ts.
In startTicketUpdateRun completion path for purpose archive: require fullMarkdown, write ticket, set frontMatter.summary, call transitionTicketStatus(..., archive), skip clarification creation.

Add archiveTicket and archiveTicketBundle orchestrators (sequential per ticket, bottom-up ordering) plus POST endpoint in src/shared/http/tickets.ts and src/http/resources/tickets.ts; wire src/services/work if needed.
Extend boardArchive.ts with taskCanArchive/showTaskArchive and sortArchiveBundleBottomUp; add relayApi/relayQueries archive mutation.
Update App.tsx: wire BoardTaskCardLeading showArchive for completed tasks; route archiveEpic/archiveFeature/archiveBundle/detail archive through new API with archiving busy state.
Add focused tests for archive purpose persistence, bundle ordering, and task archive eligibility/UI wiring.
testPlan: Extend tests/ticket-update.test.ts: archive purpose applies fullMarkdown, sets summary, moves status to archive.
Extend tests/board-archive.test.ts: task eligibility, bottom-up bundle ordering helper.
Run tests/board-archive-button.test.tsx and tests/board-task-progress.test.tsx after task card leading changes.
Manual: archive completed task from board; archive feature/epic bundle; confirm Requirements/AC remain, Archive column hidden on board, excerpt updated.
acceptanceCriteria: Completed task cards in Completed column show Archive; clicking runs summarize-then-archive and removes card from visible board columns.
Archived ticket markdown retains Requirements and Acceptance Criteria; other sections are materially shorter with task > feature > epic aggressiveness.
Archiving a feature/epic bundle processes child tasks first, then features, then epic; all end in archive with updated summaries.
Failed archive agent run leaves ticket in completed with no status change; user sees error toast.
Existing container archive gates still block premature bundle archive.
clarificationQuestions: Should archived tickets keep a one-line Context/Goal section, or may those sections be removed entirely on aggressive task archives?
assumptions: Archive uses the same default agent provider/runtime as manual ticket.update.
Context and Goal may be collapsed to brief bullets for tasks; epics keep slightly more narrative context.
Test Plan, Implementation Notes, Codex Handoff, and Agent Refinement sections are dropped or reduced to short bullets unless essential.
draft_ticket and non-completed tickets cannot be archived from the board.
Bundle archive runs tickets sequentially because beginTicketUpdate blocks concurrent updates per ticket.
implementationNotes: Follow approveScopeClarificationRedraft pattern: internal request string + purpose archive, no free-text user prompt required for board archive actions.
Consider extracting archive prompt/orchestration to src/services/codex/archiveTicket.ts if index.ts grows too large—optional, not required for first slice.
Related ticket tkt_01ks6810 (layered container review) is separate; do not conflate accept/reject review flows with archive.
